title.html: Every detail belongs to the experience.

body.html: Think in touchpoints: arrival, working, a coffee break, the bathroom and departure. A shared material palette can connect these moments. The brief distinguishes room categories from public areas so that different functions need not share the same construction. Consistency matters, but operational needs may call for a different solution.

A desk, minibar and bathroom serve different purposes. Material, proportion and branding can still connect them. We coordinate desk pads, hospitality trays, notepad holders, waste bins and tissue box covers as a coherent collection. Every piece need not look identical: a shared language comes from complementary finishes and considered details.

A single suite, a very small run of additions or accessories for a whole property: we shape the project around your requirements, with capacity for major schemes too. Room plans, reference photographs and the intended contents help define dimensions and compartments. Repeat orders are reviewed against the existing specification and current material availability.

Bring interior design, procurement and housekeeping into the conversation early. How will an item be used, cleaned and replenished? Does the tray accommodate the chosen coffee machine? Will the tissue box cover fit the specified refill? These questions belong in the sampling stage, before production begins.
Desk pads and notepad holders for suites, workspaces and meeting tables. Developed as a coordinated collection of formats, materials and branding.
